Telemetry readout DOM element IDs were misaligned in canvas_js (queried reading_* instead of val_reading_*), which prevented live measurement readouts from updating.
Observation table record button produced misaligned columns (grouped m, n, p into one cell and displaced resonant frequency, peak pressure, and degeneracy count).
Action buttons ('Toggle Waveform Freeze' and 'Auto-Tune to Degenerate State') as well as stepper up/down buttons (.stepper-btn) were unwired in canvas_js.
Animation render loop lacked freeze state support to pause standing wave oscillations and waveform phase elapsed time.
Observation table columns were misaligned: data values were shifted across columns 1-5 with an extra unrepresented history width column and hex formatting instead of binary GHR index.
Telemetry readout element IDs mismatched: elements were queried using reading_* instead of val_reading_* IDs, preventing telemetry updates.
Workload pattern action button unwired: #btn_cycle_pattern lacked a click event listener to cycle workload patterns.
Stepper buttons unwired: .stepper-btn-up and .stepper-btn-down lacked click listeners to increment and decrement stepper inputs.
